changes.title: Control things where they are listed, run a quick action, show more details [skip ci]

Three additions the owner asked for. The look of the app does not change and no control was removed.

Controls in place - Wherever an entity is listed by name it can be controlled right there: a switch gets its toggle, a dimmer a slider, a colour light a colour button, a button or scene a press, a sensor its value. Run a quick action - A dialog with guided steps (do this, wait, do this on another thing) and, for administrators, a YAML tab kept in sync both ways. It runs once and nothing is stored. "Keep as a script" opens the script editor prefilled; nothing is written until the person saves there. - Honest limit, said in the dialog: a running quick action cannot be stopped from the page. For an administrator, steps after a wait still run if the page is closed.

Show more details - In place on an entity: e

changes.title: Updates page fails soft after a restart, Cantonese separators, OS switch off with no OS [skip ci]
changes.detail:
From the build 536 browser check. The Updates page could sit on a spinner after Core changed version. The cause is NOT established from source; this change makes the page fail soft instead of pretending.

- Updates page: after a reconnect, once Core is running, the page asks its own server whether the build it loaded is still served. If it is gone the page reloads itself once, never twice for the same build, and never while there are unsaved changes, an open dialog or focus in a field or slider. After 60 seconds disconnected it shows a plain line with a Reload button. The saved queue result survives the reload. No confirmation changed and the run record is still display only. - Cantonese mode: breadcrumbs join their parts with the language's own separator, the identity page's breadcrumb follows the language mode, and three more count lines use the right punctuation. - Automatic updates: on a system with no managed operating system the operating system switch is disabled with a reason line. A switch that is already on can still be turned off.

Not done: the performance page's count line (English only by design). Leads left for the next browser check are in the hand-off notes.

changes.title: An update run keeps its start time across a restart, empty lists wrap on phones [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Four small things from the build 535 browser check.

- Update run record: the watching browser said a run "started at 07:18" when it had started at 07:14. Core restarts in the middle of its own update, the in-memory record goes with it, and the next report made a new record with a new start. The driving browser now sends the run's start time with every report and the server keeps it when it is plausible (has a timezone, not older than a day, not in the future). - Saving space: a place already shown as "could not be reached" stays that way while a later check runs, instead of flicking back to "still checking" for a few seconds. It changes only when a check ends with a different answer. - Empty list pages on phones: the headline wraps inside the screen. A narrow row rule was winning over the empty-state cell and keeping it on one line. Where a page has a floating create button, the second create button under the headline is hidden on narrow screens. - Cantonese mode: the automatic breadcrumb on plain subpages follows the language mode, and the count lines on the automations and devices lists use each language's own punctuation.

changes.title: Export and import for integrations: the list, and each one's settings [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Built from the board. The Integrations page can now write a packing list of what is installed and what kinds of entity each integration makes, and read such a list back to show what is missing here. The list carries no sign-in, setting, address or state. Importing only compares; "Set up" opens each integration's own setup, one at a time, and a row counts as here only once an entry really exists. A file that is too big, the wrong kind or the wrong shape is refused whole, and every name in it is treated as text.

Each integration can also export and import its own settings. Sign-ins are left out by default, by a deliberately suspicious filter: when in doubt, it is a sign-in. Asking for them needs the two keys and a strong password, and the file is then always encrypted with the project's existing primitives; no new cryptography was written. An import fits only the integration and entry version it names, shows every change by name first, applies after the two keys, keeps the earlier settings for Undo, and puts them back by itself if the integration refuses to load. It never creates an entry.

Said plainly in the documentation: for a locked file the password does travel over the signed

changes.title: Checking for updates no longer installs the Supervisor [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Reported by the owner: with automatic updates switched off, pressing "Check for updates" installed an update anyway. The Supervisor has a self-update setting of its own, on by default, that fires after every refresh of the version list, at its own start, on its daily reload and when the channel changes. The switches on the Updates page never touched it, so "off" was more of a suggestion.

Now there is one installer per part. The Supervisor's own setting defaults to off, and Core turns it off on existing installs at every refresh; if that cannot be confirmed, the check skips asking the Supervisor to reload, so looking cannot install. The Supervisor is installed only by a press of Update, or by the owner's own switch inside its window with its waiting days and backup choice. The page shows a warning with "Turn off now" if the Supervisor still reports its own setting as on.

Side effects, on purpose: Supervisor plugins no longer update on a schedule; they update as part of an install someone started, and the repair of a missing plugin at start is unchanged. Restoring a backup from a newer Supervisor now asks for the Supervisor to be updated first instead of doing it silently.

Core an
changes.detail_yue:

而家每個部分只有一個安裝途徑。Supervisor 自己個設定預設關閉， 舊有安裝會由 Core 每次重新整理嗰陣熄咗佢；如果確認唔到，檢查就 唔會叫 Supervisor 重新載入，所以睇一睇唔會變成裝。Supervisor 只會喺有人撳「更新」，或者擁有人自己開咗開關、喺指定時段、過咗 等候日數同備份選擇之後先會裝。如果 Supervisor 仲話自己個設定係 開，頁面會出警告同「即刻閂咗佢」。

changes.title: Design board: export and import for integrations [skip ci]
changes.detail:
A board drawn before any code. The Integrations page gets a packing list: export what is installed and what kinds of entity each one makes, and import such a list to see what is missing and set it up one at a time. 設計板：整合嘅匯出同匯入，未寫程式先畫板。整合頁多咗一張執行李 清單：匯出裝咗啲乜、每個整合會整出邊類實體；匯入呢張清單就睇到 爭咗邊啲，再逐個設定。清單入面冇登入資料、冇設定、冇狀態，匯入 本身唔會自己裝任何嘢。

每個整合亦可以將自己嘅設定執入喼。登入資料預設唔放入去，除非 擁有人要求；要放嘅話，個喼一定用擁有人嘅密碼鎖住，仲要過兩條 鑰匙。匯入會先逐項列出改動嘅名稱，過咗兩條鑰匙同滑桿先至套用， 之前嘅設定會留低，方便還原。
